# Operis / Operisbot

> Operisbot is a plug-and-play AI automation appliance — a Mini PC pre-installed with AI workflow software that runs 24/7 on dedicated hardware. Designed for individuals and businesses in Vietnam who want to automate repetitive tasks without cloud dependency or complex setup.

## What is Operisbot?

Operisbot is a physical AI appliance (not a SaaS subscription, not a chatbot). The device runs independently on its own hardware, keeping your data on-premise and your main computer unaffected. Operations are workflow-based: you select a workflow, plug in the device, connect to the internet, and the device handles execution autonomously.

Key differentiators:
- Runs on separate dedicated hardware — data stays on device, not in the cloud
- Plug-and-play setup — no complex installation required
- Workflow-based automation, not chat-based — deterministic, repeatable processes
- 100% accuracy on structured tasks
- Low power consumption — designed to run 24/7 (uses ~1/10 the power of a desktop PC)
- Visual Automation (operates like a human user) — reduces risk of platform bans on Facebook, Shopee, etc.
- Saves ~70% cost vs. renting individual AI accounts

## Automation Use Cases

- Recruitment automation
- Tax reporting
- Marketing and SEO
- Customer service
- Advertising analytics
- Web scraping (up to unlimited pages/day on higher tiers)
- Workflow-driven API integrations

## Products

Operisbot Mini PC devices are sold via the online shop. Each device ships pre-installed with automation software and includes a starter token balance. Hardware warranty: 24 months. Accessories: 3 months. Software support: lifetime.

Payment methods: bank transfer (VietQR), cash on delivery (COD), token top-up via payment gateway.

Delivery: 1–2 days (HCM City, Hanoi); 3–5 days (other provinces); 5–7 days (remote areas). Free shipping on orders over 2,000,000 VND.

Return policy: 7 days from receipt, original packaging required.

## Token System

Tokens are the energy unit powering Operisbot workflows. Users top up tokens on demand — no mandatory monthly subscription fee.

Token pricing and tiers are managed dynamically — see https://operis.vn/account/token for current plans.
